name: Bertie County, NC
findings: Bertie County has 42 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (17%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Bertie County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Bertie County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 60% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 57% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Bertie County list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 69% of the typical level).
